tips.text: Keep the Xoris after the quest; it carries Granum Void runs, and buying it back costs 145,000 standing.
Count any Xoris kill toward a Specter Particle, including the detonation's blast; the throw need not hit.
Leave Specter Particles to the Xoris; a sentinel or fast area frame that kills them first gives no charge.
Charge the Xoris with three particles, then detonate it mid-flight with the heavy attack next to a Solaris captive.
Remove Volatile Rebound and Volatile Quick Return; the Xoris's wide blast staggers you on contact.
Rebind the detonate input on controller to a face button; the default stick click is easy to hit by accident.
Unequip a bait or canister before detonating; with one equipped the detonate button can throw it instead.
Stealth-scan high-level enemies with Ivara and Noise Arrow to hit the daily standing cap fast.
